description.value: East Side Craft House is a family-owned neighbourhood pub in East Vancouver, operating since 2012 in the former Elephant Walk Pub space. It pours 16 taps of local Vancouver craft draft beer alongside fresh-grilled burgers, never-frozen chicken wings, and a rotating pub menu. The pub has a dog-friendly patio and hosts weekly community events including Wing Wednesdays, Trivia Saturdays, and NFL Sunday Ticket screenings.
